summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py (thread-entry state initialized in __init__, set/cleared in run's run_app coroutine via try/finally, scheduling via run_coroutine_threadsafe with partial binding and invoke, active-app set inside the scheduled work). Added tests/test_call_from_thread.py with 10 tests; all pass under the recorded venv with PYTHONPATH=src. Nothing committed. Caveat: unrelated async tests in tests/test_screens.py, test_unmount.py, and others fail in this environment with "async def functions are not natively supported" (pytest-asyncio missing); I did not verify them against the untouched base.
